note: How the space suit drapes in Blender's cloth (tools/characters/maker/cloth_drape.py). resolution_scale is GarmentCode's box mesh spacing in centimetres, as the kept Warp drape used it (look/<person>/space_drape/sim_props.yaml: coarser, heavier and thicker cloth than the work suit). coarse_resolution is the spacing the garment is first sewn at (cloth_drape.py says why). The Blender numbers were tuned by the drape agent on Nev's body, 2026-10-09: the sewing forces are tried in turn until no panel sags off the body, mass is per point at mass_spacing centimetres, lift raises the panels the torso hangs from while it is sewn.
